diagnosis_summary: Current public Site Detail source creates a website InteractionChannel and sets its medium, entity, name, retention, and component type, but never sets UsesSession. Because UsesSession is a non-nullable Boolean model property, a new channel retains the false default. This confirms the creation-path behavior on the reviewed source revision; the upstream issue does not yet record a fix or safe supported post-creation configuration path.

verification_playbook.goal: Determine whether a website interaction channel created by Site Detail has Uses Session disabled.
prerequisites: Know which site and website interaction channel are paired.
Have read-only access to interaction-channel configuration.

steps.title: Check the installed creation path
steps.instructions: Verify whether the installed Site Detail source still creates a website InteractionChannel without assigning UsesSession.
steps.expected_if_affected: The creation path omits UsesSession and leaves the non-nullable Boolean at its false default.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The installed path explicitly assigns the intended session setting or a later migration corrects existing channels.

steps.title: Inspect the paired interaction channel
steps.instructions: View the website Interaction Channel without saving and record only whether Uses Session is enabled. Do not record channel IDs, site domains, visitor data, or interaction records.
steps.expected_if_affected: The paired website channel exists and Uses Session is disabled.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: Uses Session is enabled, or the site does not use a website interaction channel created by this path.
evidence_to_record: website channel present yes or no
Uses Session enabled yes or no

limitations: A disabled setting confirms local exposure to the reported configuration, but it does not by itself quantify analytics impact or establish a supported remediation path.

context.scope: new web sites whose website interaction channel is created by Site Detail
